source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 1 (ISLB A1) · lesson 6. Exercises reused from the lesson.
topic: How Allah's guidance reaches us through prophets and messengers

learn.en: Allah chose special, noble people to bring His guidance to us: the prophets and messengers.
learn.title: Allah's messengers

learn.en: Allah sent His words to the messenger through the chief of the angels, Jibreel (Gabriel).
learn.title: Through Angel Jibreel

learn.en: The first prophet was Adam, and the last messenger, sent to all people, is Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.
learn.title: The first and the last

learn.en: The prophets were human: they ate, slept and felt happy and sad. We love them, but we worship only Allah.
learn.title: They were human

learn.en: Every messenger brought the same message: worship Allah alone, and be good to one another.
learn.title: One message

learn.en: The prophets are like road signs that show us the way through life.
learn.title: Like road signs

quiz.en: Allah sends His message to the messenger through Angel…
The last and final prophet was…
True or false? Allah speaks to each one of us separately to tell us what to do.
True or false? Prophet Isa (Jesus) is one of the prophets mentioned in Islam.
True or false? Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was the first prophet.

think.q: Which prophet's story do you like most, and what can you learn from him?
think.a: Any answer is great! For example, Yusuf teaches patience, and Prophet Muhammad ﷺ teaches mercy and kindness.

parents.summary: Allah guides us through prophets and messengers; Jibreel brought the revelation; Adam was the first prophet and Muhammad ﷺ the last.

try.en: Peace and blessings be upon him

parents.tip: Tell him one prophet story at bedtime this week.
